instruction: Center align the title of this document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires center aligning the first paragraph (title: 'Sample Statutory Declaration'). Evaluator checks if the first paragraph alignment is set to CENTER (value=1). The custom getter extracts the alignment property and the metric compares it to the expected value. Document must be saved for changes to persist.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator semantically and correctly verifies the instruction to center align the document title
Getter logic correctly extracts first paragraph alignment from DOCX file using python-docx library
Metric logic correctly compares alignment value (1=CENTER) with expected value
Expected value is semantically correct: alignment=1 represents CENTER alignment in python-docx
Data flow is correct: getter returns int -> metric receives rules dict -> comparison works properly
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' (expected IS the rules dict, accesses expected.get('alignment'))
Postconfig properly saves document (Ctrl+S) to persist alignment changes before verification
Complete coverage: verifies the specific requirement (center alignment of first paragraph/title)
Edge cases handled: None result, missing expected value, proper error logging
State accessibility: file is saved and accessible for reading at verification time
